_comment: Omberg's own vegetation-generator rules: flags of each generator's script (server/services/vegetation-generators.ts, by source), passed by Update vegetation and `bun run grass:zones` before any CLI flags. Seeded from Vreta's: tall-grass (pipeline/grass_zones.py) thinned with distance from play (rough, semi, fairway, green, tee, bunker) for frame time (Marcus, 2026-10-14; VSP grass cost 0.4 ms at tee 1, 1.6 ms at the hole 4 tee view); Vreta since 2026-10-15: near 18/4/0.6, far 40/10/0.5 (0.6 from 20 m, 0.3 from 50 m). 2026-10-16 (Marcus): Omberg has far fewer trees than Vreta, so the VSP grass is 30 % thicker within 30 m of play (grass-palette.json: every rough_tall texture item's sampleDistance / sqrt(1.3)) with a longer, gentler falloff: the near rule falls over 30-45 m to 0.46 (= Vreta's 0.6 / 1.3, so beyond about 45 m the density is what it was), the far rule over 55-80 m to 0.5; the two multiply, 0.46 x 0.5 x 1.3 = 0.3 of the old full density from 80 m, Vreta's 0.3. The far mix (rough_tall/far, from 40 m) is not thinned. rock-shore (pipeline/rock_shore_zones.py, 2026-10-16): the rocky shore along Vättern at the 14th green; its own defaults, nothing set here yet.
